section_summary.extract_value: This section presents preliminary analyses comparing Zimbabwean women in Britain (migrant group) with their counterparts in Zimbabwe (non-migrant group). The analyses show no significant differences between groups in age and self-reported BMI, nor in ethnic group distribution, but reveal significant differences in lifetime exposure to Western versus Zimbabwean media. The study involves two distinct geographic samples but appears to be a single comparative study.
